0x006BD2: A barrier projected from the Tower of Harmony over all of <La Gias>, supplying mana worldwide and limiting large-scale magic.
0x006D60:
Tactical Cybernetics Operating System: the OS of <Personal Trooper>s and other humanoid mobile weapons. When a pilot selects an action such as 'strike the enemy,' its AI computes both machines' positions and picks the most efficient, appropriate motion from the pattern data stored in the machine.
This frees the pilot from complex manual control: with minimal input focused on situational judgment, the machine automatically performs a suitable motion to achieve the intended action. Pilots can also set the types and execution priority of motion pattern data, tuning the machine's movements to their own habits and preferences.
0x0071E3: An uprising by the <DC> from late New Era 186 into 187. Rebelling against the Earth Federation, it seized bases across the Earth Sphere in a blitz using <Armored Module>s, but leader Bian Zoldark died in the Hagane's raid on Aidoneus Island; the DC fell into chaos and lost to the Federation Army.
0x0073E7:
A telekinesis sensing and amplification device developed by Dr. Kenzo Kobayashi of the <SRX Project>. It extracts 'T-Alpha Pulses,' deep brainwaves governing human thought, to control objects' motion and assist in piloting mobile weapons. It can also generate a Telekinetic Field, usable as a defensive barrier or rammed into enemy machines for damage. Amplified thought also widens the user's sixth-sense-like perception, helping detect and locate enemy units.
The system depends on the user's mental state, however, and excessive linkage severely strains the brain. Kenzo's project calls those whose T-Alpha Pulses exceed a set level 'Psychodrivers.'
0x007831:
A military organization founded from the <EOTI Organization> by Dr. Bian Zoldark, who foresaw an alien invasion. Its aim was a strong military regime in the Earth Sphere to oppose the invaders. It drew Federation officials and soldiers, anti-Federation activists, and liberation-front fighters, with the <Colony Integration Army> also cooperating.
In late New Era 186 it rose against the <Earth Federation Government> and its army, seizing bases across the Earth Sphere in a blitz using <Armored Module>s. But the plan of Bian and Colony Integration Army commander Maier V. Branstein was a double-edged sword: by becoming the 'enemy,' they meant to make humanity grasp its plight and rouse it to fight, yet prolonged civil war risked draining Earth's strength. They thus sought a quick end to the DC War while sparing much of the Federation's forces, and Bian would entrust the Earth Sphere's future to any strong enough to defeat him.
That contradiction invited his defeat and emboldened those exploiting the DC for selfish ends. He died in the Hagane's raid on DC headquarters; the leaderless DC fell apart and lost to the Federation Army.
0x008003: QA high-efficiency reaction thruster developed at the <Tesla Leicht Institute>. By altering gravitational mass (weight) and inertial mass (resistance to motion) separately, it accelerates propellant to drive objects efficiently - a kind of gravity control. It eases atmospheric and space flight, but early units fit only warships. Analysis of Meteor 3's <EOT> greatly advanced gravity-control physics, shrinking and improving the drive; from the <DC>'s Armored Modules on, 20-meter humanoid weapons could mount it.
